items: Timeouts with unknown outcome → idempotency keys, reconcile
Retries → at-least-once delivery, idempotent consumers
Hot keys and celebrity users → split keys, hybrid fan-out
Cache stampede → single-flight, jittered TTLs, serve stale
Replica lag → read-your-writes where it matters
Leader or node failure → failover time, data loss window, fencing
Thundering herds → backoff with jitter, admission control, waiting rooms
Abuse and bots → rate limits, signed tokens
Deploys → draining connections, backward-compatible schemas
One SLO per critical path (p99 latency, success rate)
Golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation
Pipeline health: queue depth, consumer lag, freshness
Roll out behind flags; shadow mode for risky logic
Rollback plan for every schema or config change
Reconciliation jobs where money or inventory is involved

"At 10× the first thing to break is…, so I'd…"
Fits one machine? Keep it there.
Most expensive resource: GPUs, storage, egress?
Peak = 3–5× average; plan for peak
